title: Inefficiencies of Meta Agents for Agent Design
authors: Batu El, Mert Yuksekgonul, James Zou
area: multiagent systems and inference time techniques
abstract: Recent works automate the design of agentic systems with meta-agents that propose and refine new architectures. We examine three challenges: (1) simply expanding context with all prior agents performs worse than ignoring them — an evolutionary approach helps; (2) the meta-agent commits to one agent at test time, but its designs have low behavioral diversity; (3) automated design is economically viable on only a few datasets when amortized over 15,000+ examples.
